runs.text:
Formed in 2008, Dynazty has over the years evolved from it’s humble beginnings rooted in the Scandinavian Hard Rock scene into now being a powerhouse and formidable force to be reckoned with on the top shelf of the modern melodic metal scene.

Career milestones include the 2020 chart breaking album The Dark Delight, certified for gold status in the bands home country Sweden and neighbors Finland. With single tracks Heartless Madness reaching platinum status.

Tours in recent years together with bands like Sabaton, Powerwolf, Battle Beast, Pain and Kissin' Dynamite have showcased and established the band on the European continent as one of the most prominent live acts of it’s generation.

Released on February 14th 2025, brand new album "Game of Faces" is doubling down on punch and ferocity together with the band’s trademark attention to songwriting and production detail.

Produced by Dynazty themselves and mixed by swedish pioneer Jens Bogren, Game of Faces takes you on a journey exploring the essence of the human mind and existance with lyrical themes such as self discovery, spiritual death, rebirth and re-invention in Die to Survive, Fire to Fight and Fortune Favors the Brave.
While taking on the duality and deceptive nature of human kind in the eponymous title track, the album’s opener Call of The Night and first single release Devilry of Ecstasy.
